hooks.name: Check every spec after a task
hooks.description: Runs scripts/check-spec.ps1 -All when a spec task finishes. Exit 0 puts the check lines in the agent's context; exit 1 sends the FAIL lines back to the agent.

hooks.name: Redaction check when the agent stops
hooks.description: Runs scripts/check-redaction.ps1 over the repo when the agent stops. Exit 1 sends each banned-term hit back to the agent.

hooks.name: Wrap check when the agent stops
hooks.description: Agent action, disabled by default. When enabled, the agent walks the Before-you-claim-done table over its last reply and the handoff before it stops, then fills any missing loop-log decisions.

action.prompt: Before you finish: walk the Before-you-claim-done table in 20-method over every claim in your last reply and in handoffs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md; fix any claim you cannot prove; then log the session's decisions in handoffs/LOOP_LOG.md if missing.
